Mission Bay: Penthouse Style 2 Bed + Den, 2 Bath Condo w/ Views @ The Madrone  - The new resident here will enjoy this 2012 constructed penthouse style condo with Bay and Bridge views. Located on the northeast corner of the 15th floor of the Madrone, this building offers all the conveniences you can imagine: Pool, spa, gardens, grill & dining area, screening room, resident lounge, fitness studio, attended lobby & business center. Mission Bay is home to San Francisco's biotech industry, and and an easy 5 minute walk to the CalTrain station. Some little known gems of the neighborhood include Wednesday's Farmer's Market and the Mission Rock Resort & Oyster Bar.

At just under 2,000 square feet, this is the largest floor plan available in the building. It features 2 bedrooms, a den/office (that could be used as a 3rd bedroom), and 2 full bathrooms. Perfect for entertaining, this corner unit with an open floor plan offers all the amenities you are looking for: high end appliances, hardwood floors, breathtaking views, a private terrace, washer/dryer in unit, and parking for 1 car.

Pets considered on a case by case basis, please inquire. Non-smoking unit. 12 month lease. HOA required move in/out fees/deposits to be paid by Tenant. Square footage is approximate.

(RLNE2488868)
